label: Work and limits
title: Define the work, information, and scope
hint: What task, users, and uses are allowed? What is prohibited?

label: Information and flows
title: Define the work, information, and scope
hint: Information types, origins, recipients, processing, storage, logs, exports, retention, and disposal. Identify the responsible information owner.

label: Scope and applicable obligations
title: Define the work, information, and scope
hint: Record the FedRAMP scope provision, offering/version, inclusion or exclusion rationale, other obligations, reviewer, and date.

label: Information-type ratings
title: Categorize information and the agency system
hint: For each type: confidentiality / integrity / availability impact; concrete harm; rationale; approving official.

label: System category and approval
title: Categorize information and the agency system
hint: System name, impact by objective, overall impact, aggregation considerations, approval/date, and separate privacy risks.

label: Boundary and dependencies
title: Set the boundary and allocate controls
hint: Describe or link the diagram: agency resources, provider offering, interfaces, inherited services, and exclusions with reasons.

label: Control allocation and tailoring
title: Set the boundary and allocate controls
hint: For each requirement/control: rationale, parameter, agency/provider/shared owner, implementation, evidence needed, and monitoring owner. Record SA-9 oversight and monitoring assignments.

label: Selected offering and evidence
title: Reuse FedRAMP evidence and decide whether the service fits
hint: Provider/service/version/deployment, package identifier and date, status/class or impact basis as applicable, features and inherited services covered, reviewers, and evidence links.

label: Fit, gaps, and reuse
title: Reuse FedRAMP evidence and decide whether the service fits
hint: Required capability → provider evidence → agency configuration/work → residual gap/risk. Identify stale or missing evidence.

label: Additional provider requirements, if any
title: Reuse FedRAMP evidence and decide whether the service fits
hint: Distinguish clarification from added requirements. State demonstrable need, determining official, notification/reference, package conflicts, and resolution. Enter “none” when appropriate.

label: Agreements and protections
title: Set agreements and prepare the use decision
hint: Contract/agreement reference → requirement → responsible party → evidence/remedy. Include incidents, exchanges, retention, deletion, portability, and termination.

label: Draft service-use decision
title: Set agreements and prepare the use decision
hint: Purpose/data, permitted configuration, dependencies, conditions, residual risks, owner, review triggers, and relationship to the agency ATO/ATU. Mark as draft until signed by the authorized official.

label: Agency implementation and assessment
title: Configure, integrate, and assess the agency’s implementation
hint: Implemented settings/procedures, evidence links, assessor/date, provider evidence reused, inherited capabilities checked, and integration tests/results.

label: Findings and risk response
title: Configure, integrate, and assess the agency’s implementation
hint: Finding → affected mission/information → owner → mitigation or acceptance → due date. Link provider remediation and record any agency compensating actions.

label: Decision and authority
title: Make the agency authorization decision before use
hint: System/package ID, ATO or approved ATU basis, official, decision/date, approved information/use/configuration, conditions, review/expiration triggers, and signed-record location. Record denial or deferral when relevant.

label: FedRAMP notification
title: Make the agency authorization decision before use
hint: Date, submission/reference, letter and supplemental information supplied, or explanation of why not applicable. Record any unresolved ATO/ATU procedural question.

label: Monitoring plan
title: Monitor both, respond to change, and plan exit
hint: Evidence/report → review frequency → reviewer → trigger/threshold → action/official. Include provider and agency sources, inherited services, and continuity of contacts.

label: Change, incident, and exit plan
title: Monitor both, respond to change, and plan exit
hint: Triggers for re-review, restrictions or suspension; incident coordination/notification; export/retention/deletion; account/key closure; transition owner; completion evidence.
